passages.text: The lecture distinguishes harm of allocation (withheld opportunity or resources), quality-of-service harm (degraded user experience), and representational harm (subordination or stereotyping along identity lines).
The lecture organizes sources of bias and mitigation across requirements, data, model, deployment, and monitoring, and lists pre-processing, learning-time, and post-processing mitigation methods.
The ML systems lecture presents a nine-stage workflow with feedback loops from model evaluation and monitoring back to earlier data- and model-oriented stages.
